about: Names of retired features (Kyler, PLAN.md §20 D188 (3); docs/README.md, 'Retired terms'). tests/unit/retired-terms.test.ts, in CI's quick suite, fails when one reappears in a living document, the interface text or the editor code. Matching ignores case, ** and backticks, hyphens and underscores, and line breaks, splits camelCase, and takes simple plurals (tool, tools; brush, brushes). Add a term when a feature is retired.

pendingRemoval.about: Editor files that still hold the old tools on dev. The Live editing work (feature/live-editing) empties this list as it replaces them; the test fails on a listed file that no longer holds a retired term, so the list only shrinks.
